description: Announcement history for a single A-share security. Default lookback 30 days, max 5 years. AH dual-listing: pass the A-share canonical (announcements are A-share only — HK side has separate HKEX disclosures not covered here). ⚠️ TIME: `published_at` is when the filing actually became visible — most A-share announcements go live after the previous session's close, so a filing dated "2026-08-27" by the exchange typically became readable at ~18:00 on 2026-08-26. The scheduled-disclosure stamp is the *next* calendar day at 00:00 and is returned separately as `disclosure_date`; never read `disclosure_date` as a publication time, and never conclude a filing was published at midnight.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

type.description: 分类 slug 过滤（与 feed 同集合）

name: announcements_stock
